## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criterion met
- [ ] Lint and type-check passing in CI
- [ ] Automated tests passing (coverage >= 80% on domain logic; e2e for affected flows)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, diagram, ADR if a decision was made)
- [ ] Golden cases from the accountant still passing (tax rule changes)
- [ ] Engine tag and rule table version recorded when results change
- [ ] New environment variables documented in `.env.example`
- [ ] No secrets, real client fiscal data or business-sensitive data in the repository
